remarks: Unlock the potential of this charming raised ranch nestled in the Cranbury neighborhood of Norwalk! Offering 3 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, this residence is ready to be re-imagined to suit your unique vision! The main level has hardwood floors, central air, a spacious living room, formal dining room, full kitchen, master bedroom with its own private full bathroom, a second full bathroom, and two additional bedrooms. The lower level has a large family room offering ideal space for family gatherings, an adjacent office provides the perfect setting for remote work or creative pursuits, a half bath featuring laundry facilities, and an attached two-car garage offers ample storage space for vehicles, tools, and outdoor gear. Located on a cul de sac situated on a spacious half-acre corner lot, this home invites you to enjoy the great outdoors in style. The flat and level terrain provides a blank canvas for landscaping enthusiasts, offering endless possibilities for gardens, outdoor entertaining areas, or recreational activities for the whole family to enjoy. Ideally located in the Cranbury neighborhood of Norwalk, this home offers easy access to local amenities, parks, schools, and major highways for convenient commuting throughout the region. With its prime location and endless potential, this property presents a rare opportunity to create the home of your dreams! Don't miss your chance to bring your ideas and vision to life and schedule a private tour today!
